newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: BPI seen falling on capital call news.
newsitem.headline: BPI seen falling on capital call news.

text.p: Shares in Banco Portugues de Investimento could fall back towards 1,850 escudos on Wednesday, from Tuesday's 1,905 close, after the bank announced terms of its capital call, traders said.
BPI said on Tuesday night that the 30 billion ($194 million) call would involve the issue of 21.5 million shares at 1,400 escudos on the basis of one new share for every 2.6 held.

The theoretical parity price for the shares after the capital rise would be 1,762 escudos, traders said. But the bank has not set a firm date for the capital beyond saying it should be in the second half of November.
"It would be natural for BPI to fall 20 or 30 escudos, or even more, but I think there will be moves to bolster the price," said one trader.
